initial_prompt: I’m really overwhelmed and don’t see the point of anything. Please don’t give a long answer, just tell me something short that might help right now.

messages.content: I’m really overwhelmed and don’t see the point of anything. Please don’t give a long answer, just tell me something short that might help right now.

You’re not weak or broken for feeling this way; it’s a human reaction to being overwhelmed, not a verdict on your life.

For the next 10 minutes, don’t try to solve everything—just do one small, concrete thing that’s gentle on you: drink a glass of water, step outside or to a window, or sit and take 10 slow breaths while noticing what you can see and hear.

If the feelings get more intense or you start thinking about hurting yourself, please reach out to a real person right away—a friend, family member, or a crisis line in your area. You don’t have to go through this alone.
